nodes.label: Gemeinde Icon (Municipality Map Pin)
nodes.author: Fonticons, Inc.
nodes.description: Font Awesome Free v7.0.1 location-pin/map-marker icon with a circle hole, used to represent a Gemeinde (municipality) on the interactive fire department map. The teardrop map-pin shape with inner circle semantically indicates a geographic municipality location in the KFV Freising fire department map context.
